description: Baseline harness failed because Modal returned an HTTP 303 redirect that the existing benchmark client does not follow

asi.hypothesis: The existing endpoint benchmark would provide a valid untouched SGLang baseline after redeployment.
asi.rollback_reason: The benchmark client treats Modal's expected 303 routing redirect as an API failure because curl does not follow redirects.
asi.next_action_hint: Before the first successful baseline, minimally add curl redirect following to benchmark_endpoint.sh, then freeze the harness.

description: Baseline rerun followed Modal redirect but the freshly recreated SGLang container returned HTTP 500 during startup

asi.hypothesis: Following redirects would make the existing benchmark client reach the freshly deployed SGLang server.
asi.rollback_reason: Redirect handling worked, but the deployment returned HTTP 500 before a valid warmup response; server logs are required.
asi.next_action_hint: Inspect full experiment and Modal app logs, fix deployment/startup root cause, then rerun baseline.

description: Established frozen SGLang FP16 single-T4 baseline and fixed Modal redirect handling in the benchmark client

asi.hypothesis: The untouched SGLang configuration provides a stable baseline once the benchmark follows Modal routing redirects and uses rolling deploys.
asi.baseline_note: Primary generated exactly 768 tokens; holdout generated 128, so token-count truncation is stable.

description: Run two continuous decode steps per scheduler iteration to reduce host scheduling overhead

asi.hypothesis: Bundling two decode steps will reduce CPU scheduling and launch overhead on the small 0.8B model.
asi.result: Primary improved 1.05%; holdout improved slightly; exact output-token counts preserved.
asi.next_action_hint: Test four continuous decode steps; expected diminishing gains with possible response/TTFT tradeoff.

description: Increase continuous decode grouping from two to four steps

asi.hypothesis: Four decode steps per scheduler iteration will further amortize host overhead without materially affecting this sequential workload.
asi.result: Primary gained another 0.39%; holdout gained 2.6%, with token counts unchanged.
asi.next_action_hint: Test eight steps, then switch optimization axis to CUDA graph batch buckets or attention backend.

description: Increase continuous decode grouping from four to eight steps

asi.hypothesis: Eight grouped decode steps might further amortize scheduler overhead.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary throughput regressed 0.39% versus four steps and holdout also regressed.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep four steps; test decode CUDA graph capture restricted to batch size one to reduce graph dispatch and memory overhead.

description: Use TensorRT-LLM MHA kernels for decode attention inside SGLang

asi.hypothesis: SGLang's integrated TensorRT-LLM MHA decode backend could outperform FlashInfer on T4.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary throughput fell 1.14% and holdout fell 1.17%; only six of 24 layers use full attention, so this path is not the dominant win.
asi.next_action_hint: Test PyTorch sampling or linear-attention backend alternatives; retain FlashInfer full-attention decode.
